title: Community TypeScript SDK first slice: producer-verified resource-loop operations
objective: Deliver the first Community TypeScript SDK package (@mc-plan/community-sdk@0.1.0-alpha.2, private, local pack only) on the locked community.yaml 0.1.0-alpha.2 contract and the MCP-F2-COMMUNITY-001 producer evidence (community 70e55a1 + runtime image a4654b59fb48), exposing only producer-verified operations with typed ProblemDetails, abort/timeout and bounded key-stable idempotent retries.
in_scope: New sdk/community package mirroring the sdk/typescript discipline: openapi-typescript deterministic generation from the in-repo locked openapi/community.yaml with committed raw generator output and .prettierignore exemption for src/generated and dist

SUPPORTED_OPERATIONS limited to producer-verified operations; SUPPORTED_PRODUCER_COMMIT anchored at community 70e55a1; SUPPORTED_CONTRACT_FILES embedding sha256 of every generation-input contract file

Injectable baseURL/fetch/user token provider (no OIDC flow handling), typed ProblemDetails, AbortSignal and configurable timeout, bounded idempotent retry rules mapped to per-operation contract idempotency (GET plus Idempotency-Key commands; retries never rotate the key)

Unit tests covering path/error/retry boundaries per exposed operation, pack:check clean-project strict-tsc consumption, real HTTP smoke against the fixed producer image mc-plan-community:mcp-f2-community-001-779803e
Contracts docs sync (STATUS/development-plan/api-catalog Community SDK section)
out_of_scope: Any change to community.yaml, JSON Schemas or lock files (contract zero drift, proven by generate:check and validate_contracts.py)
Any write to the mc-plan-community repository (producer evidence is read-only)
Q-009 moderation provider / Q-002 formal license decisions, npm publishing, stable version numbers
Claiming any real consumer has integrated the SDK (stabilization requires a separate real-consumer acceptance workflow)
acceptance_evidence: SDK gates green on the final tree: format:check, lint --max-warnings 0, strict typecheck, generate:check zero drift, 38 unit tests, build, pack:check clean consumer, smoke:real exit 0 twice against the fixed image
validate_contracts.py pinned venv (rebuilt: PyYAML 6.0.3/jsonschema 4.26.0) and redocly three-document lint pass with contract files byte-unchanged

Real HTTP smoke scenarios: upload session lifecycle with real signed S3 PUT, list/download pagination determinism and sha256/Content-Type byte assertions, typed negative problems (401/403/404/400/409), per-operation success regression
validation_results: Registered under the owner 2026-10-12 dispatch: Contracts line executes the Community TS SDK first slice; push authorization granted for contracts main including the three existing unpushed closed-workflow commits. Producer evidence re-verified live: MCP-F2-COMMUNITY-001 completed at community 70e55a1 with image mc-plan-community:mcp-f2-community-001-779803e (a4654b59fb48) present locally; registry had no same-goal active record (only SKIN-008, blocked, untouched). The three existing contracts commits were pushed to origin/main by the 06 master-control Phase A before this slice merged, so the final push carries only this slice's increment.

Producer-verified enumeration: all ten locked alpha.2 operations carry real HTTP integration evidence in the community repository tests (createUploadSession, completeUploadSession, createResource, createResourceVersion, publishResource, unpublishResource, getResource, listResources, listAuthorResources, downloadResourceVersion) plus the runtime image smoke; SUPPORTED_OPERATIONS therefore lists all ten with no exclusions. Auth shapes: 4 anonymous reads (listResources, listAuthorResources, downloadResourceVersion, default getResource) and 6 userOAuth commands (upload:write/resource:write + profile:read) with dual-audience tokens; all six commands declare the required 8..200 Idempotency-Key with same-key/same-request replay returning the original recorded status and body, so every SDK operation is contract-idempotent and the transport retries without rotating the key.

Implementation (10 commits on the branch): scaffold package with committed raw generated types (openapi-typescript 7.10.1, 713-line community-api.ts, .prettierignore exempting src/generated and dist; prettier-formatted pnpm-lock.yaml mirroring the core-sdk convention and verified accepted by pnpm --frozen-lockfile); typed client with 1:1 operationId methods, 11 Community-locked problem codes, bodyless commands without Content-Type, 204 void unpublish, binary download returning bytes+mediaType, client-side pre-validation (1 MiB upload ceiling, sha256 pattern, title 1..120, version 1..80, schema_version const, limit 1..100, cursor 1..2048) and anonymous reads that never send credential headers; 38 unit tests (5 files: transport timeouts/abort/bounded retries keeping the Idempotency-Key, idempotency boundaries, problem parsing, 7-file sha256 manifest recompute, per-operation client surface); pack:check with tarball name derived from the package version consuming all ten methods under strict tsc (fixed one exactOptionalPropertyTypes sample error found by the check itself); real HTTP smoke against the fixed image.

Smoke dependency form replicates the MCP-F2-COMMUNITY-001 runtime acceptance: two isolated PostgreSQL 17 containers (community + core), real Core container mc-plan-core:mcp-f1-core-012-closeout resolving the active identity via public GET /v1/me for every protected request, local JWKS test issuer (honestly attributed, NOT Keycloak; the producer's own image smoke used the same local-issuer form and its real-Keycloak PKCE evidence lives in producer integration tests), and the producer's own S3rver S3-protocol server spawned from the neighboring community checkout's installed dev dependency (read-only; no community-repository writes) with split service/public endpoints.

Smoke scenarios (all real HTTP against the fixed image): anonymous empty published page; user A provisioning via separate Core identity and creating a resource; same-key/same-request createResource replay returning the identical recorded response (order-insensitive comparison required: the producer replays through a jsonb column that drops key order) and same-key/different-request 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT; upload lifecycle with real signed S3 PUT using upload_headers verbatim then completeUploadSession 200 with sha256/size/media_type assertions; non-PNG bytes 400 UPLOAD_INVALID; complete without uploaded bytes 409 UPLOAD_NOT_READY; unknown upload id 404; 1 MiB ceiling (SDK RangeError + raw 400 VALIDATION_FAILED); version attach 202 with null download_url and immutable license snapshot; publish 202 keeping pending_moderation (runtime moderation disabled under Q-009); owner authenticated private view vs anonymous 404; publish without candidate 409 RESOURCE_STATE_CONFLICT; foreign owner 404 for version/unpublish; [SYNTHETIC-DB-SEED] labeled moderation-decision mirror of the producer ResourceWorker APPROVED writes (bytes all passed the real verify/seal path) making published read/list/download observable: anonymous getResource 200 with published_at and controlled download_url, downloadResourceVersion bytes hashing to files[0].sha256 with Content-Type image/png + attachment + nosniff + no-store; listResources and listAuthorResources cursor pagination determinism (limit 2 -> next page -> null cursor, created_at DESC/resource_id DESC order, unknown author empty page); forged and cross-surface cursors 400; missing resource:write 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE; owner view without resource:read 403; wrong-issuer and expired tokens 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED; bare no-credential request 401; malformed ids 404; raw limit=101 400 + SDK RangeError; user B fully isolated; terminal unpublish 204 void with same-key and new-key replays both 204 and every public surface of the resource disappearing immediately; all ten exposed operations covered by at least one success path.

Smoke execution: first run failed on a harness bug (string-equality comparison of the replayed response; fixed by order-insensitive canonical comparison and committed); runs two and three both exited 0, the third on the exact final committed tree. Leak check over all smoke logs: zero 'Bearer ' occurrences, zero secret values (the single case-insensitive 's3rver' hit is the ready-message word, not the static local test credential).

Final-tree gates (logs in session outputs): validate_contracts.py pinned venv (rebuilt /private/tmp/c002-validation-venv, PyYAML 6.0.3 + jsonschema 4.26.0) 20 schemas/events + 20 unique ids + 3 OpenAPI + 35 operationIds; redocly three documents exit 0 with only the expected skin.yaml no-unused-components warning; SDK format:check (after prettier-formatting pack-check.mjs), lint --max-warnings 0, strict typecheck, generate:check byte zero drift, vitest 38/38, build, pack:check clean consumer; contract files (openapi/, schemas/, events/, examples/) byte-unchanged in git status. Docs synced: STATUS (stage/versions/not-implemented/new slice paragraph), development-plan (milestone, F2 paragraph, sdk/community gate block), api-catalog (Community SDK coverage), compatibility (matrix row + SDK acceptance section + Community producer paragraph addendum), AGENTS.md (two official SDK packages). The existing sdk/typescript core package is untouched by this slice.

Closure: final_commit is the docs commit e4d6de1 (branch tip); mc-plan-contracts merges ff-only to main and the feat branch is deleted locally (remote never existed). Foundation record increments (register c8b2bf0, checkpoint 5c45089, this completion) stay local for the 06 master-control Phase B push together with the other sessions' in-flight record commits, per the 06 Phase A live ruling that deferred the Foundation main push until 01/03/04 close; this session does not push Foundation itself.
